Tier.label: Party level
Tier.hint: Damage scales with the SRD severity table; DCs stay as written.

Affects.trigger: Only the one who stepped in

pit.name: Hidden Pit
pit.text: A plank lid covered with dirt gives way under weight. A slightly sagging floor gives it away. Athletics wedges the lid shut.
pit.flavor: The floor gives way — a black pit opens beneath!

spikedPit.name: Spiked Pit
spikedPit.text: A hidden pit with sharpened stakes at the bottom. The fall hurts twice: the impact and the spikes.
spikedPit.flavor: The floor collapses — spikes glint below!

bearTrap.name: Bear Trap
bearTrap.text: Steel jaws hidden under straw or leaves. A caught creature stays put until freed with Athletics or thieves' tools.
bearTrap.flavor: Steel clangs underfoot — the jaws snap shut!

poisonDarts.name: Poison Darts
poisonDarts.text: A pressure plate fires darts from hidden tubes in the walls. Tiny holes in the masonry give it away; the tubes can be plugged.
poisonDarts.flavor: Darts whistle out of the walls!

arrowVolley.name: Arrow Volley
arrowVolley.text: A tripwire looses a volley from arrow slits. Everyone in the area is under fire.
arrowVolley.flavor: A click — and arrows rain from the slits!

scythingBlade.name: Scything Blade
scythingBlade.text: A heavy blade swings out of a slot in the ceiling and sweeps just above the floor. The slot and scratches on the walls give the mechanism away.
scythingBlade.flavor: A huge blade whistles down from above!

fallingNet.name: Falling Net
fallingNet.text: A net hangs under the ceiling; a tripwire drops it. Those caught stay put until they work free.
fallingNet.flavor: A heavy net drops from the ceiling!

collapsingRoof.name: Collapsing Roof
collapsingRoof.text: The supports are sawn through, and a tripwire brings the ceiling down. Cracks and fresh dust on the floor are the warning.
collapsingRoof.flavor: The vault groans — and stones rain down!

rollingBoulder.name: Rolling Boulder
rollingBoulder.text: A pressure plate releases a stone ball that thunders through the corridor and knocks everyone down.
rollingBoulder.flavor: A rumble grows — a boulder rolls down the corridor!

fireJet.name: Fire Jet
fireJet.text: Nozzles in the walls spray flaming alchemical oil. Soot around the holes and the smell of oil give it away.
fireJet.flavor: Flame roars out of the walls!

acidSpray.name: Acid Spray
acidSpray.text: A pressurised vessel sprays acid on whoever steps on the plate. The floor around is pitted with burns.
acidSpray.flavor: A hiss — and acid splashes in your face!

poisonGas.name: Poison Gas
poisonGas.text: A plate opens valves and the room fills with caustic gas. The GM may have the door slam shut.
poisonGas.flavor: Greenish smoke creeps out of the cracks!

sleepGas.name: Sleep Gas
sleepGas.text: A sweetish gas puts everyone in the area to sleep. A sleeper wakes when damaged or shaken awake.
sleepGas.flavor: The air turns sweet, eyelids grow heavy…

lightningRune.name: Lightning Rune
lightningRune.text: An invisible glyph on the floor strikes whoever steps on it with lightning. Arcana or dispelling disables it.
lightningRune.flavor: A rune flares underfoot — lightning strikes!

frostRune.name: Frost Rune
frostRune.text: A glyph of cold covers everyone nearby in rime. The floor near it is always a little colder.
frostRune.flavor: The rune flares blue and the air rings with frost!

thunderPlate.name: Thunder Plate
thunderPlate.text: A plate carved with a glyph answers a step with a thunderclap that knocks everyone nearby off their feet. It can be heard far away.

witheringSigil.name: Withering Sigil
witheringSigil.text: A dark sigil drains life from everyone on it and fills them with dread. Dangerous even for seasoned heroes.
witheringSigil.flavor: Shadows reach out of the sigil and cold bites to the bone!

alarmPlate.name: Alarm Plate
alarmPlate.text: Harmless, but it rings loudly: guards and monsters learn they have guests. The GM gets a notice.
alarmPlate.flavor: Somewhere above, a bell starts ringing!

App.attempt: Try to disarm with the selected token

Notify.gmOnly: Only the GM can do this.

Notify.notDnd5e: Trap Library is made for D&D 5e: checks and damage won't work in another system.

trapId.label: From library
trapId.hint: The built-in or custom trap this one was made from.

icon.label: Icon
icon.hint: Font Awesome icon class, e.g. fa-solid fa-fire.

attackBonus.label: Attack bonus
attackBonus.hint: If set, the trap attacks against AC instead of forcing a save.

damage.label: Damage
damage.hint: A formula such as 2d10. Empty — no damage.

condition.label: Condition
condition.hint: Applied on a failed save or a hit.

sound.label: Sound
sound.hint: A built-in sound or a path to your own file.

stops.label: Stops movement
stops.hint: A token that steps in stops on the trap (pit, bear trap, net).

fixedDamage.label: Damage ignores party level
fixedDamage.hint: Like falling into a pit: 1d6 per 10 ft.

fxMode.name: Animations
fxMode.hint: Built-in animations always work. If Sequencer and JB2A are installed, their effects can be used instead.

applyDamage.name: Apply damage automatically
applyDamage.hint: Otherwise the chat card only reports the result and the GM applies damage.

chatMode.name: Trigger card
chatMode.hint: Who sees the trap result in chat.

passiveDetect.name: Passive Perception
passiveDetect.hint: A player character coming near a trap notices it if their passive Perception meets the detect DC.

detectRange.name: Detection range (ft)
detectRange.hint: How far from a trap passive Perception and searching work.

detectSight.name: Spot only in line of sight
detectSight.hint: Walls that block sight and closed doors stop a character from spotting a trap — by passive Perception or a search.

triggerBy.name: Who sets traps off
triggerBy.hint: Traps can fire only on player characters, so the GM can move monsters freely.

mapButtons.name: Trap buttons on the map
mapButtons.hint: The GM sees an eye button on every trap: one click reveals it to players or hides it. Each GM has their own setting.

detectMode.name: When a character spots a trap
detectMode.hint: What happens when a Perception check succeeds (passive or a search). Also switchable on the On this scene tab.
detectMode.reveal: Reveal it to players on the map right away; whisper the player
detectMode.gm: Tell the GM who spotted it; reveal to players by hand

Device.title: Device
Device.hint: Describe the trap in the world's terms — damage, DCs and conditions follow on their own.
Device.controlled: Set by the device: changes when its settings change.
